name: Ayunosu Meguru
source:
The honest and pure daughter of the school board chairman.

Second-year student in Class D at Ayunosu Academy. A student in the class where the protagonist serves as homeroom teacher.

The daughter of the Ayunosu Academy chairman, who is the protagonist's mentor. While serious by nature, she possesses a strong curiosity.

She cannot resist trying her hand at things that interest her. An honor student who occasionally tends to run wild.

She respects and holds the protagonist in high regard as her teacher.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/turibaka/]official site[/url]]
